description: This file defines the class 'FormatWithCompetency' which implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to format employee language competency values based on a predefined mapping.

classes.name: FormatWithCompetency
classes.description: A formatter class that maps an entity value to a competency string using a static array.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the competency string corresponding to the entity value, or null if not found.
